id.description: Unique claim code record identifier (UUID v4).

petId.description: Foreign key to the pet this claim code is issued for.

emailHash.description: SHA-256 of lowercase email supplied during the claim flow. Must match claim_identities.email_hash for the OTP to be accepted.

codeHash.description: SHA-256 of the 6-digit numeric OTP. Plaintext OTP is never stored.

expiresAt.description: OTP expiry timestamp. Set to NOW() + 15 minutes at creation.

usedAt.description: Set when the OTP is successfully verified. NULL if unused.

attempts.description: Informational counter incremented on each verify call. Enforcement is in Redis.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the claim code row was created.
